summary: Reviewed workflow-manifest.json, workflow-manifest.schema.json, and orchestrator/src/config.py. All 9 roles have persona_file_deep_agents with consistent N-name.md naming convention; original persona_file (Claude Code) is unchanged. Schema correctly adds persona_file_deep_agents as optional with minLength:1 and corrects the persona_file description from VS Code to Claude Code. Config.py change is minimal: one line replacing persona_file with persona_file_deep_agents in the PERSONA_FILES dict comprehension, with an updated docstring that accurately describes the change. One low-priority note: the field is optional in the schema but accessed unconditionally in config.py — recommend adding to required[] in the schema as a follow-up.

comments.note: No blocking or Fix-Forward issues found — code is clean and consistent.

Latent brittleness: persona_file_deep_agents is marked optional in workflow-manifest.schema.json (not in required[]) but read unconditionally in config.py (r["persona_file_deep_agents"]). All 9 current roles have the field so no KeyError risk today, but if a future role omits it the orchestrator will crash at startup. Options: (a) add persona_file_deep_agents to the schema required[] array to enforce presence at the schema level, or (b) use r.get("persona_file_deep_agents", r["persona_file"]) as a safe fallback. Currently not blocking. Recommend the schema approach (option a) as the next author touches this file.
